newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DRUG BAN FOR WELSH FORWARD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DRUG BAN FOR WELSH FORWARD.

text.p: Wales B second row forward Paul Jones has been banned for two years by a Welsh Rugby Union tribunal after admitting taking the anabolic steroid testosterone.
The ban has been backdated to August because the 24-year-old Llanelli player owned up to his club's medical officer before he was tested.
Jones said he had taken injections of testosterone to help him recover from a shoulder injury.
